f814W.astrometry_note: this is the --align tweakreg lens: the re-drizzle lands 180 mas (3.6 px) from the archived product on the sky. Measured content shift +1.47 rows, +0.01 cols; cutout_cr_mask.fits and cutout_cr_mask_arcs.fits were shifted by the integer (+1,0) and NOT redrawn, leaving a 0.47 px residual (MASKSHFT / MASKSHRS header cards). Positions: none on this lens.
